purpose: Manual editorial intent decisions for articles whose core word count falls in the 700–1,200 heuristic band. These decisions are not Google word-count rules; they record whether a focused article should be retained or received a substantive evidence update.

black-sea-food-crisis-2026.rationale: Retain as the corridor-and-delivered-cost explainer; the Russia–Ukraine page covers the exporter and route network, while this page explains how shipping, insurance and importer substitution transmit into grain markets.

countries-most-exposed-food-crisis-2026.rationale: Retain as a comparative country-exposure framework covering import concentration, purchasing power, reserves and conflict access; the humanitarian hotspot pages answer a different question about acute need.

cut-grocery-bill-when-food-prices-rise.rationale: Retain as the household affordability guide focused on receipts, unit prices, meal costs, substitutions and waste; it is not a stockpiling or emergency-pantry checklist.

egypt-wheat-bread-crisis-2026.rationale: Retain the Egypt-specific wheat procurement, subsidised baladi bread, mill and fiscal pass-through analysis; its buyer-specific response is not interchangeable with other importer country pages.

el-nino-winners-losers-crop-risks-2026.rationale: Retain as a cross-region crop-calendar comparison showing why El Niño impacts differ by crop and place; the NOAA-focused page covers the climate signal rather than regional crop exposure.

europe-food-security-72-hours-2026.rationale: Retain as a comparison of national civil-protection preparedness guidance and resilience layers; it does not claim that a 72-hour household plan measures European food reserves.

fao-food-price-index-explained-2026.rationale: Retain as the indicator-methodology explainer for the FAO international commodity index; the monthly country tracker measures national consumer-price series.

fertilizer-independence-resilient-farmin.rationale: Retain as the long-term structural policy page on domestic capacity, import diversity, soil and nutrient efficiency; the fertilizer-shortage page covers the near-term disruption and crop-stage response.

fertilizer-shortage-2026.rationale: Retain as the near-term fertilizer market and farm decision article, with distinctions by nutrient, delivery window and crop stage; long-term fertilizer independence remains a separate policy topic.

germany-harvest-drought-food-prices-2026.rationale: Retain as the Germany-specific harvest, milling-quality, river transport and bread-price pass-through case; a national crop total alone cannot answer the local market questions.

gulf-food-security-2026.rationale: Retain as the Gulf-market resilience comparison across import concentration, ports, cold chains and reserves; the Hormuz page focuses on the geopolitical route and indirect transmission channels.

how-can-world-prevent-food-crisis-10-sol.rationale: Retain as the cross-sector prevention framework mapping policy tools to local failure points and time horizons; country pages apply those tools to individual situations.

how-governments-build-food-reserves-2026.rationale: Retain as the public reserve governance and infrastructure explainer, distinguishing target stocks, physical stocks, quality, release rules and climate-appropriate storage.

how-to-stockpile-food-and-water-sensibly.rationale: Retain as the household quantity, rotation and storage-capacity planning method; the pantry article evaluates food types and the water article covers water safety.

how-to-store-water-at-home-safely.rationale: Retain as the household drinking-water safety guide about source, container, hygiene, storage conditions and local authority instructions; agricultural water scarcity is covered separately.

japan-rice-prices-food-security-2026.rationale: Retain as the Japan-specific rice price and reserve-policy analysis distinguishing contracted purchases, physical deliveries, releases and market transactions.

nigeria-hunger-crisis-2026.rationale: Retain as the Nigeria-specific Cadre Harmonisé assessment and state/livelihood response analysis; the regional hotspot comparison is broader and does not replace the Nigeria detail.

philippines-food-water-el-nino-2026.rationale: Retain as the Philippines-specific PAGASA, province, irrigation and rice crop-calendar analysis; it translates the wider ENSO signal into local water decisions.

russia-ukraine-grain-exports-2026.rationale: Retain as the exporter and origin-side analysis of Ukrainian and Russian logistics, port capacity and export continuity; the Black Sea page explains the broader market transmission.

southeast-asia-rice-prices-2026.rationale: Retain as the regional rice market comparison distinguishing paddy, milled rice, export quotations and household prices across national systems.

sudan-food-crisis-2026.rationale: Retain as the Sudan-specific conflict, displacement, IPC period and access analysis; the four-emergency comparison deliberately does not replace this country detail.

sudan-yemen-somalia-gaza-famine-risk-202.rationale: Retain as the comparative humanitarian assessment explaining why classifications, periods, geographies and operational responses differ across four emergencies.

turkey-wheat-harvest-food-inflation-2026.rationale: Retain as the Türkiye case study on a strong harvest coexisting with food inflation, exchange-rate effects and local harvest/market decisions.

us-food-prices-2026.rationale: Retain as the United States fertilizer, state-level drought and winter-wheat conditions analysis; the national price-transmission article covers broader global mechanisms.

very-strong-el-nino-2026-food-production.rationale: Retain as the NOAA signal-to-field evidence article with climate, field and market decision gates; the crop-risk comparison page covers regional outcomes.

water-crisis-food-crisis.rationale: Retain as the agricultural water-system explainer separating rain-fed, canal, groundwater, reservoir and desalination-dependent production.

why-global-food-prices-rising-2026.rationale: Retain as the price-transmission explainer tracing export quotation through currency, freight, handling, processing and retail; commodity index and country tracker pages serve different functions.

why-people-stockpiling-food-2026.rationale: Retain as the behavioural explainer on why households buy extra and how demand surges create shelf gaps; the fact-check article tests viral claims against source evidence.

uk-food-shortage-2026.rationale: Updated with the published UK Be Ready three-day guidance, official household water planning figure and 2025 national food-supply measures; supersedes the earlier press-reporting-led treatment.

pakistan-flour-wheat-food-security-2026.rationale: Added PBS October urban and rural wheat-flour CPI movements plus the 12 November 17-city weekly SPI quotation, preserving the distinction between basket inflation and a local retail price.

food-inflation-by-country-monthly-tracke.rationale: Added the October 2026 BLS, ONS and Eurostat readings with precise measure labels and release periods, avoiding invalid cross-country rankings.

oil-energy-food-prices-2026.rationale: Updated the FAO October price baseline and added a channel-by-channel test for fuel, gas/fertilizer, electricity and marine freight pass-through.

strait-of-hormuz-food-crisis-2026.rationale: Updated FAO's November cereal trade baseline and added a route-exposure matrix that separates direct fertilizer flows, indirect energy exposure and importer buffers.

food-collapse-fact-check-2026.rationale: Updated cereal and price baselines and added a claim-to-source matrix and source-quality hierarchy so viral assertions can be checked against the right evidence.

food-prices-2027-forecast-scenarios.rationale: Rebased the conditional 2027 outlook on FAO's November production, trade and stock forecasts and added commodity-specific scenario interpretation without inventing probabilities.

when-will-food-crisis-end-2026.rationale: Added a dated recovery dashboard that separates price, production, trade, stocks and humanitarian access rather than assigning one speculative end date.
